cards.text:
V-TD03/001EN
Navalgazer Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Aqua Force｜ Grade 3｜ Power 12000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC):When it attacks, if it is the third battle of that turn or more, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], [Stand] one of your rear-guards, and this unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of that battle.

V-TD03/002EN
Marine General of the Raging Waves, Gondikas
Normal Unit｜ Aqua Force｜ Grade 3｜ Power 12000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](RC):When it attacks a vanguard and is not boosted, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of that battle.

V-TD03/003EN
Marine General of the Restless Tides, Algos
Normal Unit｜ Aqua Force｜ Grade 2｜ Power 9000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](VC):When it attacks, if it is the second battle of that turn or more, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], and [Stand] one of your rear-guards.
[AUTO](RC):When it attacks, if it is the first battle of that turn, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and [Stand] this unit.
